Sasha — thanks for the notes and the draft. Appreciate the clarity on timing; we can support an Oct 5 target if we align quickly. A couple of quick responses before a working session: 

1) Connector Bundle swap — we can model a re-allocation of units into the Connector Bundle and hold your current uplift ladder in place for the first 6 months post-amendment. After that, the uplift tiers would apply to incremental usage. That gives you predictable unit economics during the initial run-in.

2) Mid-contract top-up protection — two pragmatic options we typically propose: an uplift cap (we can set a cap at +20% uplift on baseline for Q4 bursts) or a true-up credit where any overage above the cap is converted into a refundable credit applied to the next renewal. Both options add complexity to billing but are doable.

I've attached a quick pricing model (redwood_pricing_model_connector_swap_v3.csv) with an illustrative cap at 20% and an alternate true-up credit column. Can the Ellipsis team review and mark a preference?

I'll coordinate a 45-minute working session — Jordan, Kimberly, Priyom: can you join an internal prep at 9am PT tomorrow? Sasha / Ana: would 11am PT tomorrow work for a joint call?

Best,
